description: The fixer's triage of the deep review report and its fixes: a disposition for every finding of the report, notes on the rest, the change and the pushed head

dispositions.description: Exactly one item for each finding in the findings of the deep review report in request.inputs, identified by its id; empty when it has no findings

id.description: The finding's id in the report

action.description: fixed: changed in a commit of this Step. not_fixed: left as it is

reason.description: Why the finding was fixed this way or left as it is

notes.description: What was done with the report's other items and why, and what remains unconfirmed; empty when there is nothing to note

correction.description: Where this Step left the worktree HEAD. committed: at a new commit after the pull request record's reported_head. no_change: still at that reported_head

head.description: The worktree HEAD at the end of this Step, which, when committed, is the commit pushed to the pull request record's branch
